policy.patch: 0.x.y contains compatible fixes and narrowly necessary tests/documentation. A bug label or migration alone does not settle compatibility.
policy.priority_legend: P1: consequential security/integrity or required production evidence; P2: moderate affected-workflow risk; P3: later improvement. Priority is assessed here, not a GitHub label or a release-necessity score.
policy.size_legend: S: bounded surface; M: several paths or a race; L: cross-layer/client/deployment work. These are planning estimates, not day commitments.

standing_rules: Implementation PRs do not touch release-planning/. After a wave's PRs merge, one planning PR records them: ledger rows, PR links, decisions and GitHub writes, then refresh.py and render.py (maintainer rule, 2026-10-21: per-PR dashboard edits made every parallel PR conflict).
Every PR keeps docstring coverage at or above 80% for the functions in each file it creates or edits, counted before the first push.
Run refresh.py before render.py whenever GitHub milestones or issue states have changed. refresh.py reads GitHub only and never writes to it.
A newly found or disclosed library vulnerability goes into the next release (maintainer policy, 2026-10-24); Dependabot PRs carry that milestone.

decisions.question: What goes into the interim 0.5.5 release?
decisions.answer: Maintainer, 2026-10-24: master as of v0.5.4 onward (PRs #1080-#1089 already merged) plus nine items cherry-picked from 0.6.0, four full (#1056, #1047, #1034, #486) and four groundwork (#1021, #796, #483, #770/#771). Later added: #1103 (ADR-0053 Q1(b) implementation) and #1104 (ADR-0031 prerequisite 1).

decisions.question: #1034: where are grid spacing and snap stored?
decisions.answer: Per user, locally (browser); no template document field, no schema change.

decisions.question: #486: does the onboarding (database-stored) country go into 0.5.5 as migration 0319?
decisions.answer: Deferred. 0.5.5 ships the environment half only, with InstallationCountry::Get() as the seam; the database half waits on #484 and on #486 Q1/Q2, and the precedence rule needs a record first.

decisions.question: #483: write a new ADR-0054 or revise the existing Proposed ADR-0031?
decisions.answer: Revise ADR-0031 in place (option A). ADR-0054 is unused.

decisions.question: ADR-0053: the six ADR-0049 part 2 questions.
decisions.answer: All six on the recommended options: inactive printer's and worker's jobs stay queued; other Resolve refusals dead-letter; cancellation is its own state; reprint is the only recovery; no schema change. Accepted in #1107; Q1 built in #1105; dead-letter reason display is #1102 (0.6.0).

decisions.question: ADR-0031 open questions.
decisions.answer: US plus common GS1 member-organisation layouts, cited (prerequisite 7); US default 2IIIIIVPPPPC; unmapped country has no default. Default computed at read time. /api/scan answers unknown for an unreadable vctl: label. SHOPPINGLIST_VIEW gets a reduced product payload. Still Proposed.

decisions.question: ADR-0055 open questions.
decisions.answer: Bundle plus single-leaf scopes, none for admin; user keys retire after phase 2 only where an authorization server runs; no write introspection; dynamic registration, no metadata documents; built-in server off by default; client scope ceiling fixed at registration. Proposed.

decisions.question: ADR-0056 open questions.
decisions.answer: Authentik issues production tokens, Entra ID upstream; one issuer; bootstrap admin stays local; break-glass is the strictest login mode; linked users may create keys until retirement reaches their install; add an audit table. Proposed; never accepted before ADR-0055.

decisions.question: Where do the groundwork issues go after 0.5.5?
decisions.answer: #483, #486, #770, #771 and #796 move to 0.6.0, each with a comment on what 0.5.5 delivered and what remains. 0.5.5 closes at 28 of 28.

decisions.question: Where do dependency vulnerability fixes go?
decisions.answer: Maintainer policy, stated 2026-10-24: a newly found or disclosed library vulnerability goes into the next release. #1101 (zod in mcp/) and #1108 (zod in the hydra spike, MCP client in the parity harness) are 0.5.5.
